 Renishaw inVia Qontor Confocal Raman 
Renishaw inVia Qontor Confocal Raman 
Raman spectroscopy coupled with optical (light) microscopy.
Variety of lasers available: 532, 633 and 785 nm.
Measure molecular vibrational modes/phonons for study of chemical bonding in samples.
i.e. identification of materials & present in samples.
Mapping with spatial resolution down to ~ 250 nm.
In situ measurements during heating/cooling, etc. to study electrochemistry.
